headline: U.S. finalizes lower fuel-economy standards for cars and light trucks

supports: The U.S. Department of Transportation finalized a rule resetting NHTSA Corporate Average Fuel Economy standards.
The final rule lowers the fuel-economy requirements compared with the prior administration's standards.
The U.S. Transportation Department finalized sharply lower vehicle fuel-economy standards on September 28, 2026.
The action reverses stricter fuel-efficiency policy adopted under the prior administration.

claim_checks.claim: The U.S. Department of Transportation finalized lower Corporate Average Fuel Economy standards on September 28, 2026.

caption:
🇺🇸 The U.S. Department of Transportation finalized lower federal fuel-economy standards for passenger vehicles and light trucks, reversing stricter requirements adopted under the previous administration. The department says the change is intended to reduce vehicle costs and expand consumer choice; the rule also allows higher fuel consumption than the prior standards.

🇪🇸 El Departamento de Transporte de EE. UU. finalizó estándares federales de eficiencia de combustible más bajos para vehículos de pasajeros y camionetas ligeras, revirtiendo requisitos más estrictos adoptados por la administración anterior. El departamento afirma que el cambio busca reducir el costo de los vehículos y ampliar las opciones del consumidor; la norma también permite un mayor consumo de combustible que los estándares anteriores.

Sources: U.S. Department of Transportation / Reuters — Sept. 28, 2026.
